answers.solution:
The repository referenced in the problem isn't present locally (`/workspace` only contained `problem.json`), so I built a self-contained, runnable reproduction of the pattern and verified it against a real PostgreSQL 18 cluster.

## Deliverables

- **`/workspace/SOLUTION.md`** — the complete write-up (title, root-cause analysis, exact fix, verification).
- **`/workspace/solution/`** — runnable Go module demonstrating and testing the fix.

```
/workspace/solution/
├── queryer.go        # shared {Exec; QueryRow} interface for pool *and* tx
├── errors.go         # ErrCreatorProfileNotFound sentinel
├── repos.go          # Create/CreateTx, Add/AddTx + compile-time assertions
├── service.go        # validate-first + Begin/committed/deferred Rollback
├── handler.go        # sentinel -> 404 PROFILE_NOT_FOUND
├── schema.sql
└── integration_test.go
```

## Verification (real PG, not mocks)

```
=== RUN   TestCreateWorkspace_UnknownProfile_404AndNothingPersisted
--- PASS
=== RUN   TestCreateWorkspace_HappyPath
--- PASS
=== RUN   TestCreateWorkspace_ChildInsertFailureRollsBackParent
--- PASS
PASS
ok  example.com/pgxtwo  0.020s
```

The third test is the key one: it forces the child member insert to fail via a check constraint and asserts `count(*) == 0` for the parent workspace, proving the transaction boundary genuinely rolls back rather than just relying on validate-before-write.

## Root cause in one line

Two pool-backed writes ran sequentially with autocommit (`workspaces.Create` then `members.Add`), so a child FK failure left the parent committed, and the untyped error fell through the handler switch to `500`. The fix validates the profile first (sentinel error), runs both writes through shared `*Tx` helpers on one SQL body inside a `pool.Begin` + deferred-rollback transaction, and maps the sentinel to `404 PROFILE_NOT_FOUND`.
